Manufacturers and suppliers referenced across the
[Equipment](../equipment/index.md) catalog.

## What lives here

Each vendor has its own page, and this index links to them. Vendors are referred
to by name, and logos are not reproduced, see
[Sources & citations](../about/sources.md). When citing a vendor's manual, link
to the official copy rather than hosting it.

## Articles

- [Colorado Time Systems (CTS)](colorado-time-systems.md): aquatics timing,
  scoring, and display systems; Loveland, Colorado.
- [Daktronics](daktronics.md): electronic scoreboards and LED video displays, and
  the now-discontinued OmniSport aquatic timing line; Brookings, South Dakota.
- [FINIS](finis.md): swim training tools and unpowered pool equipment, including
  the Backstroke Start Wedge; Livermore, California.
- [International Sports Timing (IST)](international-sports-timing.md): aquatic
  timing systems, scoreboards, and the SWIMSTART start system; a division of
  Industrial Service Technology, Inc., Grand Rapids, Michigan.
- [Seiko](seiko.md): timing, measurement, and display systems for sport, including
  the PS-1400 start sound generator and the certified swimming system built around
  it; Seiko Time Creation Inc., Tokyo, Japan.
- [Superior Swim Timing (SST)](superior-swim-timing.md): laptop-based swim timing
  software and equipment, including the Atlantis start system; founded 2010.
- [Swiss Timing](swiss-timing.md): the Swatch Group's timekeeping company, whose
  Quantum aquatic timing appears under the Omega brand at major meets; Corgémont,
  Switzerland.

More manufacturers are added as equipment is documented.
